definitions: A list of films associated with a particular person, such as an actor, director, or producer.
A comprehensive list of films, often categorized by genre, director, or year.
examples: Her filmography includes over fifty movies.
The director's filmography spans several decades.
We studied the filmography of classic Hollywood.
The book contains a complete filmography.
synonyms: cinematography (less common, but can refer to the body of film work)
